title: All modules over a constant field sheaf are flat
statement: Let J be a Grothendieck topology on C, essentially small in an independent universe m, with weak commutative-ring sheafification, abelian sheafification in universe m, and the local-bijectivity property there. For any field kappa [def-weil-field], every module sheaf N [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] over its associated constant field sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules] for siteSheafTensorRight.

proof.text: For a finite relation, intersect the image sieves of its finitely many coefficients. Local surjectivity of the constant-field unit makes this a covering sieve. On each arrow all coefficients lift to field elements.

Restrict the action on N(V) along the unit ring homomorphism from kappa. This is a vector space and is free, hence projective and flat. The field lifts satisfy the original relation after restriction. Apply Module.Flat.isTrivialRelation_of_sum_smul_eq_zero to obtain a finite factorization.

Map the factorization coefficients back along the unit. The expressions for module entries and the zero coefficient sums remain valid by the ring-hom identities. The independent-universe local relation criterion gives sheaf flatness.
